ammonia.reason: Mucor mucedo deamination and urease deacidify pH 4.43 to ~7.0 releasing NH3

animal_barnyard.reason: Tyr/Trp catabolism to p-cresol/indole during intense proteolysis

bitter.reason: massive accumulation of hydrophobic peptides by Mucor + Lactococcus proteinases with no salt/fat masking

blue_moldy.reason: no Penicillium roqueforti, very low fat so almost no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone

browning.reason: high-protein low-fat curd yellows/browns via Maillard and mold enzymes on heating/ripening

buttery.reason: skim milk <0.5% fat gives almost no milkfat diacetyl/acetoin retention

cheesy_sweaty.reason: very limited butanoic/hexanoic acids due to <0.5% fat substrate despite lipolysis

creaminess.reason: <1% fat and granular acid-cooked curd gives no creamy mouthfeel

crumbliness.reason: acid-precipitated cooked skim curd at ~45% moisture fractures granular

firmness.reason: dense 50% protein low-fat matrix cooked 90-95C in whey is hard-firm

floral_honey.reason: limited Phe-derived phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol, suppressed by pungent notes

fruity.reason: almost no fat for ethyl butanoate/hexanoate synthesis by esterase

goaty.reason: cow skim milk lacks caprine 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic acids

melt.reason: acid-heat set low-pH history and <0.5% fat prevents flow, only softens

mushroom_earthy.reason: surface Mucor mucedo produces 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one earthy notes

oil_off.reason: no milkfat to exude free oil on heating

sour_vinegar.reason: initial lactic/acetic acid largely consumed by mold deacidification to pH ~6.9

stretch.reason: acid curd never pasta-filata stretched, no aligned casein fibers

sulfur_cooked.reason: 90-95C whey cooking plus Met catabolism to methional/dimethyl sulfide

sweet.reason: lactose fully fermented by Lactococcus, no residual sugar

umami.reason: extensive proteolysis releases free glutamate and savory peptides
